summary_en: ¥500M upper limit, 260,000 shares (2.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market acquisition window Aug 7 – Nov 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled. Rationale: capital policy in light of growth investment plans, liquidity, and market environment.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Miyoshi Oil & Fat disclosed on August 6, 2026 that its board has authorized a share buyback program under the Companies Act Section 156 (read in conjunction with Section 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 260,000 ordinary shares, representing 2.5% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥500 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 7 through November 30, 2026. The company states it will cancel all acquired shares. The rationale cites capital policy considerations encompassing future growth investments, available cash resources, and prevailing market conditions including share price. As of July 31, 2026, the company held 5,990 treasury shares (excluding 95,359 shares held in an executive compensation BIP trust) against 10,300,905 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
